companies.name: NOWFIT Sports Nutrition Sagl
companies.distributes: Protein bars, keto wafer cookies and protein snacks from other brands (Pro Nutrition, Ethic Sport) alongside sports nutrition
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop, direct sales at its Viganello (Lugano) office and warehouse by appointment, and gyms, fitness centres, food stores, shopping centres and vending operators
companies.sf_brands_carried: Keto wafer cookies and high protein bars from Pro Nutrition and Ethic Sport
companies.fit_rationale: A Lugano-based sports nutrition retailer that already sells bars and wafer cookies from other brands to health-conscious shoppers, and also supplies gyms, food stores and vending operators. Diablo's bars, wafers and cookies match that shelf. It holds stock at its Viganello warehouse.
what_they_do_well: Sells from its Lugano warehouse to shoppers and to gyms, food stores, shopping centres and vending operators, with sales offices in Wallisellen and Meyrin.

companies.name: SamaraNatura (BioSamara GmbH)
companies.distributes: Healthy snacks, fruit and nut bars, energy and protein bars and vegan chocolate from other brands (Rawbite, Roo'Bar, COCOA, Booja-Booja, Naturkostbar)
companies.channels_supplied: Its own Swiss online shop priced in CHF, with free delivery from CHF 100
companies.sf_brands_carried: Better-for-you bars and vegan chocolate from Rawbite, Roo'Bar, COCOA and Booja-Booja
companies.fit_rationale: A Swiss organic and health food online shop with a snacks section built on outside brands of bars and vegan chocolate. Diablo's vegan muesli bars, wafer and cookie suit this health-conscious shopper. Delivery area within Switzerland is not stated on the snacks page; the shop calls itself a Swiss online shop.
what_they_do_well: Member of the Swiss retail association Handelsverband.swiss.

companies.name: NutrirSi Bio Market
companies.distributes: Organic, vegan and gluten-free food including bars (Rawbite), chocolate and spreads (Rapunzel) and biscuits and bars (Rhythm 108)
companies.channels_supplied: Its shop at Via Carlo Frasca 4, Lugano, and its online shop with free delivery
companies.sf_brands_carried: Better-for-you snacks from Rawbite and Rhythm 108
companies.fit_rationale: A Lugano organic shop with an online shop that carries Swiss and foreign organic brands, including bars, chocolate and spreads. Diablo's vegan bars, jams and peanut butters suit its shoppers. Tier 3 because it is a single shop.
what_they_do_well: Sells the leading Swiss and foreign organic brands from one shop in central Lugano with free home delivery.

companies.name: Free From Food (Publipoint Sagl)
companies.distributes: Gluten-free biscuits, sweet snacks, savoury snacks and breakfast products from other brands (Nutrifree, Le Veneziane, Barilla)
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop based in Ticino, shipping orders to shoppers
companies.sf_brands_carried: Free-from (gluten-free) biscuits and snacks from Nutrifree
companies.fit_rationale: A Ticino online free-from shop with biscuits and sweet snacks categories stocked with outside brands. Diablo's cookies, biscuits and wafers suit shoppers who already buy special diet products. Tier 3 because it is a small online shop and its delivery area is not stated on its website.

companies.name: drogi.ch GmbH
companies.distributes: Protein bars and protein snacks from other brands (More Protein, ESN) and glucose sweets (Livsane) in its sports nutrition range
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online drugstore shipping across Switzerland by DPD, and a drugstore in Escholzmatt
companies.sf_brands_carried: Protein bars and snacks from More Protein and ESN
companies.fit_rationale: A Swiss online drugstore with a sports nutrition range that already sells bars and sweets from outside brands. Diablo's bars and sweets would sit with these health-conscious lines. Tier 3 because it is a smaller online shop.
what_they_do_well: Online drugstore with over 25 years in the drugstore trade.

companies.name: Vitaminplus (Welldro AG)
companies.distributes: Protein bars (Sponser, Lifefood) and a healthy snacks section alongside vitamins and natural food
companies.channels_supplied: Its online shop with druggist advice, and the Welldro drugstores
companies.sf_brands_carried: Lifefood raw bars and Sponser protein bars
companies.fit_rationale: The online shop of the Welldro drugstores, with a healthy snacks section and bars from outside brands. Diablo's bars and snacks fit its health-conscious shoppers. Tier 3 because food is a small shelf in a mostly supplements range and the drugstore count is not stated on its website.

companies.name: Powershop Luescher + Co.
companies.distributes: Protein bars (Weider) in a sports nutrition range from many brands (ESN, Optimum Nutrition, Powerbar, Sponser)
companies.channels_supplied: Its own Swiss online sports nutrition shop and its shop in Safenwil
companies.fit_rationale: A Swiss sports nutrition shop with a bars category stocked from outside brands such as Weider. Diablo's bars and snacks suit its fitness shoppers. Tier 3 because the bars range seen is small and delivery to Ticino is not stated on its website.
